card.name: Adverb stems before -ly endings
card.fires_on: The stem of an adverb that is still unfinished, right before an ending like -ically, -ively or -ly. It fires on stems such as unjust, analy, morph, symptom, linear, quant and support, usually after a verb.

modes.label: Stems awaiting -ically
modes.description: A stem of a technical adjective that needs -ically or -atically to finish the adverb.
modes.example: treat<< symptom>>atically, and institute supportive measures

modes.description: A plain stem that takes -ly or -ively to become a manner adverb after a verb.

card.writes: It promotes adverb endings such as -ically, -ally, -ively and -ously, which complete the unfinished adverb.
card.plain: It marks an adverb that has been started but not yet finished, where the model expects an ending like -ically or -ively.
